name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: Child measles deaths in New York and Wisconsin; US cases top 4,800
state: A child died of measles in Wisconsin, the state's first such death since 1990, STAT reported on 5 Nov, two days after New York reported its first measles death in three decades. US cases passed 4,800 as the disease surges in several states (CIDRAP). This is a large outbreak in a high-income country; a multi-country surge with rising deaths has not been confirmed.
for_you: Check that you and your children are up to date with MMR vaccination; the NHS and CDC publish guidance. Unvaccinated infants and children are most at risk.
rubric_hit: Watch: large outbreak in a high-income country (US 4,800+ cases)

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
